title: `VAR_*` and `STDDEV_*`: Welford/West, Chan merge
description: All state is `DoubleType`, the count too. The update is Welford/West: `delta = x - avg`, `deltaN = delta / (n + 1)`, `avg += deltaN`, `m2 += delta * (delta - deltaN)`. Partial states merge as `m2.l + m2.r + delta * deltaN * n1 * n2`, with `delta` forced to 0 when a side is empty.
No values is NULL; the sample variance of one value is NULL (NaN under `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate`). No clamp.

`var_samp`/`variance`/`stddev_samp`/`stddev`/`std` take the sample (`distribution: SAMPLE`), `var_pop`/`stddev_pop` the population. Every input type, `BIGINT` and decimals included, is cast to `DOUBLE`, and the result is `DOUBLE`. The probes: one value gives NULL for the sample forms and 0.0 for the population ones (NaN for the sample forms with `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate`); 1e9 + {4, 7, 13, 16} gives exactly 30 and 22.5, Welford's update cancelling no digits there.
Probed (`sverify_dev.probe_statistics`): `VAR_SAMP` 30 and `VAR_POP` 22.5 of {4, 7, 13, 16} shifted by 0, 1e6, 1e8, 1e9 and 1e12; values whose textbook variance in doubles is negative give 0.0.
reference: `AggFn.var` (`varOf`, `core/Sverify/Core/Aggregate.lean`) is two-pass with native doubles in list order: the mean (`floatSum` / n), then the squared deviations from it, added from +0.0, by n or n - 1, and never below 0. A sample of one value is NULL. Only NULL and the sign are exact; engines may differ in the last bits (#54) until #85 bounds the error.
